Could you fetch the details for me? Also, include the match statistics. Lastly, I recently measured my weight and height. I weigh 75 kilograms and my height is 1.8 meters. Could you calculate my Body Mass Index (BMI)?"

preferences.description: Optional preferences of stay at the hotel. Default is all if not specified.

function.name: soccer_get_last_match

function.name: calculate_BMI
function.description: Calculate the Body Mass Index (BMI) given a person's weight and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight_kg.description: The weight of the person in kilograms.

height_m.description: The height of the person in meters. This is a float type value.
